en:
<CLT=cltMIND>These monitors are everywhere,
but I don't see any cameras.

<CLT=cltMIND>How is the mastermind behind this
killing game monitoring us?

<CLT=cltMIND>Or...are we not really
being watched at all?

<CLT=cltMIND>Bottles of poison line the shelves
behind the glass door.

<CLT=cltMIND>Some that will kill you instantly,
some that have other effects...
<CLT=cltMIND>Case files, lined up for me to read.

<CLT=cltMIND>They contain photographs of murder
scenes and the <CLT=cltSTRONG>tricks the culprits used<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know if these are real cases,
but they all seem plausible.

<CLT=cltMIND>The first few files have only illustrations,
but the others have photographs...

<CLT=cltMIND>Is there a reason for that?
Are the old ones <CLT=cltSTRONG>just fictional<CLT=cltMIND>?
